held_out_outcomes: Target Neotoma counts are excluded from each site's prediction process and opened only in scoring after its prediction JSON has been written.

fixed_clr_rbf.distance_scale: median positive pairwise distance among the two outer-training sites, recomputed per bin and fold
fixed_clr_rbf.training_zero_handling: add 0.5 to each declared training taxon only

grouping: one Neotoma dataset/core/site per physical site group; no Rootsi workbook rows are included
scores: per-site-bin pollen fraction MAE and Hellinger; macro average bins within sites, then equal-weight sites
prior_exposure: Prior local review of source data and design means exploratory development evidence, not an untouched confirmatory test.
